summary: Build skills matrices, capability maps, and action plans with a practical 5-day course. Train your team to close capability gaps.
lede: Skills gap analysis and capability mapping help HR, workforce-planning, learning and talent professionals compare required role capabilities with current proficiency. The course covers building role profiles and skills matrices, assessing evidence through self-assessments, manager input and work samples, and prioritizing gaps by severity, risk and impact. Participants use findings to plan reskilling, internal mobility or hiring, and create development roadmaps and capability reports.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who need to assess skills, map capability, and plan targeted workforce development using evidence rather than guesswork.
modules: Skills Matrix and Heat Map Design
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of HR processes, role profiles, or workforce planning terminology. Prior experience with competency frameworks, survey data, or basic Excel reporting will help, but no programming is required. For best results, bring a sample job family, role profile, competency list, or workforce planning challenge from your own organization.
